Everyday dentistry

Root canal treatment

Treatment focused on preserving your natural tooth.

Ask about this treatment

Understanding your options

Root canal treatment removes infected tissue from inside a tooth. The canals are cleaned and filled, and the tooth is restored. Your dentist will explain whether the tooth can be treated and whether a crown may be needed afterwards.

What to expect

  1. Assess the tooth and take imaging if needed.
  2. Clean and fill the root canals under local anaesthetic.
  3. Restore the tooth and arrange any necessary follow-up.

A common question

Will I need more than one appointment?

Root canal treatment often takes more than one visit. Your dentist will explain the expected stages and how the tooth will be protected between appointments.

Your consultation is the place to discuss suitability, benefits, risks, alternatives and costs for your individual care.
